content: Perform lipid screening only after achieving optimal glycemic control, and repeat this assessment annually to monitor lipid levels. Target lipid profile goals should include LDL cholesterol levels below 100 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol levels above 35 mg/dL, and triglyceride levels below 150 mg/dL. If the desired lipid targets are not achieved, dietary modifications should be implemented. If lipid levels remain elevated after six months of dietary intervention, pharmacologic treatment should be considered. Initiate statin therapy if LDL cholesterol levels exceed 130 mg/dL and do not improve despite lifestyle modifications.
